text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and Stock D after gains and buying more of other stocks changed my allocation; I should check those choices against a target plan rather than react to recent prices.","Buying more after declines can increase concentration and risk, so I should assess each position's role and my overall exposure before adding.","Short-term account swings, including the recent recovery, are not evidence of a predictable trend; I should make measured decisions and avoid letting frequent checking drive unnecessary trades."]}
